g.text: 28-Agent Parallel Audit · AST Taint · Remote Git Scanning · 4-Tier Verification · Autonomous Fix
28-AGENT PARALLEL AUDIT & AST TAINT CORE
DETERMINISTIC
• 28 Concurrent Agents: Prompt Injection · MCP Abuse · Memory Poisoning · RAG · Pickles · Auth
• AST & Taint Engine: Pure ESM Babel (JS/TS) & Python CST with ScopeTree & Source-to-Sink Taint
• 100% Offline & Free: 0 token cost, 125 secret & code patterns, 7 cached Threat Intel feeds
Raw Findings & AST Taint Graphs
8-FRAMEWORK STANDARDS MAPPING & ABOM
COMPLIANCE
• 8 Security Standards: OWASP LLM 2025 · MITRE ATLAS · NIST AI 600-1 · EU AI Act (Art 12/14) · ISO 42001
• CycloneDX 1.5 ABOM: Full Agent Bill of Materials (Prompts, Tools, Models, Skills & MCP Trust)
• Scoring Engine: Computes 0–100 Health Score & Letter Grade (A–F) with Category Deductions
Deep Analysis / `praxis fix` Trigger
COGNITIVE LLM REASONING & PATCH DRAFTING
AGENTIC AI
• Multi-LLM Router: Anthropic Claude · OpenAI · DeepSeek · Google Gemini · Local Ollama (`--local`)
• Exploitability Triage: Evaluates call-site reachability & attack vectors to eliminate false alarms
• Autonomous Code Fix: Drafts contextual, multi-file code patches & unit regression tests
Draft Diffs to Verification Oracles
4-TIER EXECUTABLE VERIFICATION LADDER
ORACLES
• Tier 1 (AST Syntax Oracle): Validates AST node integrity before any file is touched
• Tier 2 (Build Oracle): Executes project build (`npm run build` / `tsc`) to ensure 0 compiler errors
• Tier 3 (Test Suite Oracle): Runs unit test suite to guarantee zero functionality regressions
• Tier 4 (Re-scan Oracle): Confirms finding resolution — Auto-reverts on any oracle failure
Verified Diffs to Operator Review
HUMAN APPROVAL, ATOMIC APPLY & REPORT SUITE
HUMAN-IN-LOOP
• Interactive Diff Review: Developer inspects verified patch before any disk write
• Atomic Apply: boundary + symlink checks, all-or-nothing rollback, hash-based `praxis undo`
• Assessment Report: single-file tabbed HTML — agent coverage, AST taint, ledger, trend
• CI/CD Native: Net-new PR gating, SARIF export to GitHub Code Scanning & PR annotations
↻ AUTONOMOUS FIX → VERIFY LOOP
OUTPUT SURFACES & REPRODUCIBILITY
READ-ONLY
• Web UI: `praxis web` — Security Studio, live SSE, loopback-only, secrets redacted
• Portable Rules: `praxis rules export` — 411 pattern rules as Semgrep YAML
• Code Scanning: SARIF carries numeric `security-severity` so alerts rank properly
• Reproducible: scan fingerprint + CI determinism gate over `file::rule` identities
Node.js ≥ 18 · Pure ESM · 28 Security Agents · 4-Tier Verification Ladder · Multi-LLM Autopilot
